title: Wonder
subtitle: Notice • Wonder • Explore

title: Make Sense
subtitle: Reason • Represent • Explain
blurb: Tasks with more than one right path. Students compare, represent, and have to say why.

title: Play & Solve
subtitle: Games • Puzzles • Challenges
blurb: Thinking that looks like play. Low prep, high repeat value, and students ask to do them again.

title: Build Fluency
subtitle: Flexible thinking • Facts • Practice
blurb: Fluency built on strategy and number relationships — not on speed drills.

title: Reflect & Justify
subtitle: SMPs • Discourse • Reasoning

title: Support Learning
subtitle: Intervention • Progress monitoring • IA resources
blurb: For the students who need something more, and for the adults supporting them.
